title: Toilet Paper Stand 26-Inch Solid Brass Freestanding European Style | Best Sellers Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
When wall space is at a premium, this freestanding toilet paper stand keeps a roll right where you need it—beside the toilet—without drilling into tile or drywall.

  • Place it anywhere: freestanding design is ideal for bathrooms where wall mounting isn’t practical.
  • Stable on the floor: heavy base is designed to help prevent tipping.
  • Quick roll changes: European-style hook makes replacing the roll fast and simple.
  • Coordinate your bath: part of the Best Sellers Collection, a fit for transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories.
  • Built to last: crafted from solid brass with multiple designer finish options available.

Specs

  • Product dimensions (L x H x W): 6.75 in x 26 in x 5.5 in
  • Box dimensions (L x H x W): 9 in x 9 in x 29 in
  • Shipping weight: 6 lb
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
  • Assembly: Assembled in the USA
